title: CutPaste: Self-Supervised Learning for Anomaly Detection and Localization
mechanism: Cut a patch or a thin 'scar' strip and paste it elsewhere in the same image. A classifier learns to spot the paste, and its features localise real anomalies.
evidence: Widely cited MVTec baseline (1,281 citations per the index). Numbers not re-checked this session.
adaptation: The scar variant is a thin line pasted inside the same cell, so it can serve as a cheap pretext on pool cells. In the benchmark it is the second anomaly-detection baseline next to DRAEM.
min_experiment: CutPaste trained on crack-free train cells. Report crack AP and relF1@2 on test and E1. Benchmark baseline, no kill line.
